mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fraud_flags WHERE type = #{type} AND resolved_at IS NULL AND created_at > #{since} AND tag_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{tagId} AS uuid) AND customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(#{customerId} AS uuid))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fraud_flags (id, customer_id, tag_id, type, severity, details, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{customerId}, #{tagId}, #{type}, #{severity}, CAST(#{details} AS jsonb), #{now})
